verdict.rationale: Phaser's documentation and community evidence confirm 2D-first design: Scenes, sprite/game objects, Arcade physics with velocity/gravity/collision shapes, animation via frame-based Animation Manager, a unified input system, and an asset Loader for sprite sheets/atlases/tilemaps — all core 2D primitives, not add-ons. Community testimonials independently corroborate it as a leading 2D-focused engine ('best one for 2D games', '2D, sprites, tilemaps, physics' fits perfectly) with no mention of 3D at all, reinforcing 2D-only focus as first-class rather than secondary. Missing for 10: no dedicated first-party docs excerpt specifically on tilemap editor/system depth beyond loader mention, and no explicit contrast statement disavowing 3D support.
